base: black-and-white editorial vintage documentary photograph, desaturated, high contrast, grainy film texture. SQUARE 1:1 aspect ratio. Dense haze; the ENTIRE UPPER THIRD of the image is bright, pale, empty and hazy, fading to near-white at the top edge for clean compositing. Subject dark, low in the frame. No text, no words, no logos, no gradients, no added color, no stock photo look, no clutter.

images.scene: Camera resting on an old Brazilian sidewalk of black-and-white Portuguese mosaic stones (calcada portuguesa), extremely low, at ground level, looking along the sidewalk. In the sharp foreground, a few old coins lie scattered on the stones, then more coins further along in a loose trail leading away from the camera. At the far end of the trail, small and out of focus, a man in simple worn clothes walks AWAY from the camera, seen from behind, unaware, one hand in his trouser pocket, dissolving into the pale haze. Hard raking side light, strong texture on the stones and the coins. No faces, no text.

Immaculate minimal still life. ONE old pair of worn work trousers, only the hip and pocket area visible, large in the lower half of the frame, against a smooth very dark, almost black background. The pocket is turned slightly and has a small frayed HOLE at the bottom seam; a single coin is caught halfway through the hole, and one more coin is frozen mid-air just below it, falling. Hard side light picking out the fabric weave and the metal. Nothing else in the frame; the darkness lifts into pale haze towards the top.
